result:
I fixed F-DG2-430: the React warning "Cannot update a component (`AssignDialog`) while rendering a different component (`RecordDialog`)" no longer appears in any unit test run, on Node 22 or 24, in either locale setting. All required checks were run in both locale settings and passed, except `pnpm format:check`, which exits 2 in both because the sandbox blocks a few files (details under "Checks run"). Nothing is committed. The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/T-DG2-FE9-frontend-ux-engineer.md`, with logs in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/T-DG2-FE9-evidence/`.

**Fix.** In `RecordForm.tsx`, the state update is now pure. The parent's `onValuesChange` is called from an effect after the change is committed: once per change, never for the starting values. The Team assign dialog's role preview behaves as before: it starts on the role that opened it, follows each role change, disappears when no role is selected, and stays put while other fields are edited.
- **One small widening:** `onValuesChange` now also fires after a save-conflict "reapply" or "discard" replaces the form values. The Team dialog only creates records and can't hit a conflict, so nothing changes there.

**Sweep.** I read every state updater in `apps/web/src`, plus reducers and query-cache updaters. One other was impure: the "Add step" button in `JourneysSection.tsx` generated a random ID inside the updater, so a double run under StrictMode would get a different ID. The ID is now generated before the update. All the others are pure; the handback has the full table.

**Tests.**
- **Guard:** `apps/web/test/react-warning-guard.ts`, installed in `test/setup.ts`, fails a test only on React's "Cannot update a component …" and act() warnings. All other `console.error` output is passed through unchanged and never fails a test. A self-test checks it against React's real warning and confirms ordinary error messages are ignored.
- **Preview test, EN and AR:** it runs under StrictMode and steps the role through WL → KDS → TD → none → WL, checking the preview text each time. I also extended the e2e Team journey (chromium-en and chromium-ar) to switch the role to KDS and back.
- **Negative control:** with the old `RecordForm.tsx` swapped back in, the guard fails the existing "403" test, and each new preview test fails on its own (exit 1). React prints this warning only once per pair of components, so each locale's test was also run alone.

**Checks run** (each with locale unset and with `LANG=C.UTF-8`):

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| typecheck, build, lint | exit 0 |
| `pnpm format:check` | exit 2: Prettier can't read 12 sandbox-blocked dotfiles (permission denied). It found no formatting issues. |
| `--ignore-path` variant | exit 0 |
| `pnpm test` on Node 22 and 24 | 790 of 790 passed each time |
| `grep "Cannot update a component"` | no matches in any test log; it appears only in the three negative-control logs |
| contrast check | PASS |
| e2e (P1, P2, `p2-blank-text.spec.ts`) in chromium-en and chromium-ar, `--workers=1` | 60 passed in both runs |
| axe | 0 violations of any impact |
| `validate.mjs --historical --stage DG1` | `PASS`, exit 0 |

**Other warnings in the logs** (all explained in the handback):
- **Unit tests:** one Fastify deprecation warning in each run, from an API test outside my scope.
- **Build:** a 500 kB chunk-size warning, already present in FE8's build log.
- **e2e:** `npx` warnings about unknown npm config keys.

**Things you should know:**
- **Screenshots aren't in the repo.** The assignment says evidence must be logs only, but my role rules ask for screenshots, so the two conflict and I followed the assignment. I viewed the new EN and AR screenshots of the KDS preview and they look right; any e2e run regenerates them.
- **HEAD moved during start-up.** The orchestrator committed `2cb64c2`, which only changes `findings.json`, so the code under test matches `be51ad7`.
- **Not closed.** The finding needs verification by a reviewer other than me.
